title: Worker presence record (minion.presence/1)
$comment: The public record one Worker instance publishes for other programs on the same host (R2 writes it). Public by construction: it names the instance, the daemon version, the OS scope, the Hub origin and the coarse Hub connection state only. The Hub origin is scheme, host and optional port: no user info, path, query or fragment. It never holds the Hub owner, Worker name, keys, words, pairing code, session data or errors. Solo has no hub_origin. Times are UTC unix milliseconds. A reader treats the record as running only when state is running and now - updated_at < stale_after_s.

os_scope.description: Who runs the daemon: a non-root OS account or root.

hub_origin.description: Scheme, host and optional port of the Hub; absent in Solo.

hub_link.description: Coarse state of the Hub connection, for a reader that cannot ask the Worker: connected (usable), registration_pending (registration with the Hub is not finished), disconnected (a Hub is configured but not reachable), none (no Hub: Solo). Absent when the daemon does not say. Never holds an owner, credential or error text.
